To Whom It May Concern,  

I have worked directly with George Adamu over the past 18 months as a Data Engineer Consultant at Strategic Data Solutions. In this role, George has consistently delivered reliable, scalable solutions to complex data challenges, balancing technical rigor with a collaborative approach to team dynamics.  

George’s expertise in Apache Kafka has been a critical asset. He designed a real-time data ingestion pipeline for a client’s customer analytics platform, reducing latency by 40% and enabling faster decision-making. His ability to own end-to-end workflows—from schema design to monitoring—demonstrated both technical depth and ownership. Similarly, his work with Apache Spark optimized batch processing jobs, improving query performance by 30% while maintaining compliance with enterprise data governance standards.  

Beyond technical skills, George’s problem-solving mindset stands out. During a Kubernetes migration project, he proactively identified bottlenecks in our CI/CD pipeline, implementing Docker containerization that streamlined deployment processes. His attention to detail and willingness to mentor junior engineers further strengthened team productivity.  

George’s contributions extend beyond tools—his adaptability and ethical approach to data engineering have consistently aligned with our company’s strategic goals. He thrives in dynamic environments and brings a calm, methodical perspective to high-pressure scenarios.  

I am confident George will bring the same level of dedication and technical excellence to any new opportunity. Please feel free to contact me at [email] for further discussion.
